landing.hero_title: Community of Practice in Public Policy Evaluation
landing.hero_desc: The centre of excellence for evaluation professionals in Côte d'Ivoire. Collaborate, learn, and strengthen the impact of public action.
landing.overview_desc: Join over 300 experts who collaborate daily.
landing.directory_desc: Find the right profile by area of expertise.
landing.highlight_desc: A platform operated by the Ministry, guaranteeing the confidentiality and security of your professional exchanges. No data shared with third parties.

landing.pillar2_desc: Access hundreds of reports, guides, and studies. Our integrated AI helps you synthesise long documents to extract the essentials in seconds.

landing.role3_desc: Exchange best practices and develop your skills.
